step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features two user groups (Scientists and Business Analysts) accessing the application via CloudFront. Traffic flows into a central edge Lambda function, which queries DynamoDB for fine-grained authorization. Authorized web user requests route to a Remix Lambda, while programmatic API requests route to a GraphQL Lambda. Both backend Lambdas query a shared Aurora PostgreSQL database.
